name: Samia Sharmin
title_line: Architect | Writer | Content & Brand Strategist | Heritage Researcher | Educator

homepage_intro.short: Architecture-trained writer, researcher, and design communicator working across architectural storytelling, heritage documentation, material narratives, editorial writing, and built-environment communication.
homepage_intro.long: Architecture-trained writer, content strategist, educator, and heritage researcher with experience across building-material brand strategy, architecture-focused editorial work, publication coordination, research documentation, exhibition and gallery support, youth and event coordination, and design communication. Skilled in translating architectural, material, cultural, and institutional knowledge into clear public-facing content for specialist and general audiences. Experienced in editorial workflows, interviews, visual coordination, campaign brief development, academic teaching, archival documentation, heritage programming, large-scale event facilitation, and cross-functional stakeholder coordination.
